registries.title: Extension registries
registries.explanation: Add a registry endpoint or paste a public GitHub repository URL. Its extensions appear in this existing list.
registries.connectedHelp: Extensions from these sources are merged into the existing Apps listing.
registries.accessTokenHelp: Stored encrypted with this Shopware installation's APP_SECRET and sent only to the registry origin.
registries.clearAccessHelp: Leave empty to switch this registry to anonymous access.

entitlements.title: Update entitlements
entitlements.explanation: Grant customers access to plugin updates independently of orders. Paid orders issue linked entitlements; refunds and cancellations disable them.
entitlements.empty: No update entitlements have been created yet.
entitlements.orderHelp: The order must belong to the selected customer and sales channel.
entitlements.validUntilHelp: Leave empty to keep the entitlement valid until it is disabled or deleted.
entitlements.searchPlaceholder: Search customer, product, sales channel or order
entitlements.noResultsHelp: Adjust the search term or filters.
entitlements.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this entitlement?

publication.title: Seller publication
publication.explanation: Valid Shopware plugin ZIPs attached as digital-product downloads are published automatically. Invalid files remain private and are listed here.
publication.empty: No digital-product downloads are available for publication yet.

productDownloads.connect: Connect this product to Extension Mesh
productDownloads.connectHelp: Valid plugin ZIP uploads are published to ExtensionMesh. Other digital products keep their standard download handling.
productDownloads.repositoryManaged: This product is connected through its seller repository.
productDownloads.error: The Extension Mesh downloads could not be updated.

repositories.title: Seller repositories
repositories.connectedHelp: Stable release assets are checked automatically every 15 minutes.
repositories.empty: No seller repositories are connected yet.
repositories.tokenHelp: Required only for private repositories. Grant read-only Contents access.
repositories.productPlaceholder: Select the digital product to link
repositories.importNotice: Creates an inactive draft product. Set its price and visibility before publishing.
